newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific shares down on correction.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific shares down on correction.

text.p: Shares of CITIC Pacific Ltd fell Tuesday midday following Monday's sharp jump on expectation of possible future placements after the company's management said it would buy a 15.47 percent stake, brokers said.
CITIC shares fell HK$0.70 or 1.54 percent to HK$44.90 a share in midday trade on volume of 3.23 million shares. They surged HK$2.00 or 4.59 percent on Monday.

"It's a correction after the recent gain but we expect a limited downside due to underlying hot demand for China-related stocks or red-chips," said Edwin Cheung, a sales manager from Taiwan Securities.
